predictor.notes: Minimal-complexity affine predictor for quantities 1–1000, not an established exact pricing law. Approved quotes returned 140645 cents at quantity 50 and 182157 cents at quantity 200; exports in the second session independently confirmed both values. The predictor reproduces both exactly after rounding. All tested estimate/alias requests were denied, as were additional approval/export probes, including quantities adjacent to the approved points. The application explicitly advertises exact approvals only for 50 and 200. Consequently, the other 998 predictions are unverified: nonlinear or piecewise alternatives can match both observations, and neither transitions nor a finite prediction-error bound can be determined. Exact reconstruction across the full domain is not identifiable from the available observations. Used 18 business requests and 3 REA operations, including inspection.
